title: The Internet
short: A network that connected the world.
description: The Internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks. It grew from early research networks into the infrastructure behind communication, commerce, science and modern culture.

title: World Wide Web
short: A web of pages linked by hyperlinks.
description: Invented by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN, the World Wide Web made information on the Internet easy to access through browsers, URLs and hyperlinks.

title: Modern Computer
short: A machine that transformed calculation.
description: Modern electronic computers evolved from mathematical theory, wartime engineering and advances in electronics. They became general-purpose tools for science, business and everyday life.

title: Alan Turing
short: A pioneer of theoretical computer science.
description: Alan Turing formalized the idea of a general-purpose computing machine and made foundational contributions to codebreaking and artificial intelligence.

title: Artificial Intelligence
short: Building machines that perform intelligent tasks.
description: Artificial intelligence studies how machines can perform tasks associated with human intelligence, including learning, reasoning, perception and language.

title: Printing Press
short: Knowledge became easier to reproduce.
description: Johannes Gutenberg's movable-type printing system transformed the scale and cost of reproducing texts in Europe, accelerating the circulation of ideas.

title: Electricity
short: The force behind the electric age.
description: The study and practical control of electrical phenomena reshaped industry, communication, lighting and modern technology.

title: Isaac Newton
short: Laws of motion and universal gravitation.
description: Newton's laws of motion and universal gravitation unified the study of motion on Earth and in the heavens, shaping classical physics.

title: Albert Einstein
short: Reimagined space, time and gravity.
description: Einstein's theories of special and general relativity transformed physics and changed how scientists understand space, time, energy and gravity.

title: Evolution
short: How life changes across generations.
description: Evolution by natural selection explains how inherited variation and differential reproductive success shape the diversity of life over generations.

title: DNA Structure
short: The molecular blueprint of life.
description: The double-helix model of DNA revealed a structure capable of storing and copying genetic information, transforming biology and medicine.

title: Moon Landing
short: Humanity's first steps on another world.
description: Apollo 11 landed astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin on the Moon in July 1969, a defining moment in space exploration.

title: Apollo Program
short: A bold engineering journey to the Moon.
description: NASA's Apollo program mobilized scientific, industrial and engineering expertise to land humans on the Moon and return them safely.

title: Renaissance
short: Art, inquiry and ideas flourished.
description: The Renaissance was a period of renewed interest in classical learning, artistic experimentation and human-centered inquiry across Europe.

title: Industrial Revolution
short: Machines transformed work and society.
description: The Industrial Revolution began a shift toward mechanized manufacturing, new energy systems, urbanization and modern industrial economies.

title: Steam Engine
short: A new source of mechanical power.
description: Improvements to the steam engine made reliable mechanical power available for mines, factories, railways and ships.

title: World War II
short: A conflict that reshaped the modern world.
description: World War II was a global conflict that transformed geopolitics, technology, international institutions and societies.

title: Transistor
short: The tiny switch behind modern electronics.
description: The transistor made compact, reliable electronic switching and amplification possible, enabling modern computers and digital devices.

title: Semiconductors
short: Materials at the heart of digital devices.
description: Semiconductor materials can control electrical current, making them essential to transistors, integrated circuits, sensors and processors.

title: Smartphone
short: A computer and camera in your pocket.
description: The modern smartphone combines mobile communication, computing, cameras, sensors and Internet access in a pocket-sized device.

title: Climate Change
short: A changing climate with global consequences.
description: Human-driven climate change is primarily caused by greenhouse gas emissions from energy use, industry, agriculture and land-use change.

title: Charles Darwin
short: Natural selection changed biology.
description: Charles Darwin developed the theory of evolution by natural selection, providing a unifying explanation for the diversity of life.

title: Vaccination
short: Training the immune system to prevent disease.
description: Vaccination uses a biological preparation to stimulate immune protection against infectious diseases, preventing illness and saving lives.

title: Johannes Gutenberg
short: A key figure in European printing history.
description: Gutenberg developed a practical movable-type printing system in Europe, helping make books more widely available.

title: Miguel de Cervantes
short: Author of Don Quixote.
description: Cervantes wrote Don Quixote, a landmark work often considered one of the foundations of the modern novel.

title: TCP/IP
short: The common language of the Internet.
description: TCP/IP is the foundational suite of communication protocols that allows diverse networks and devices to exchange data.

title: Artificial Satellites
short: Orbiting tools for a connected planet.
description: Artificial satellites support communication, navigation, weather forecasting, Earth observation and scientific research.

title: GPS
short: Precise positioning from space.
description: The Global Positioning System uses satellite signals to provide positioning, navigation and timing services around the world.

title: Reformation
short: A movement transformed by printed ideas.
description: The Protestant Reformation reshaped European religious and political life. The printing press helped pamphlets and translations circulate widely.

title: Globalization
short: People, economies and cultures interconnect.
description: Globalization describes the growing connections among countries through trade, technology, migration, culture and communication.

title: Agricultural Revolution
description: The shift from foraging to farming enabled permanent settlements, food surpluses and larger societies.
short: The shift from foraging to farming enabled permanent settlements, food surpluses and larger societies.

title: Writing
description: Writing preserved laws, records, stories and knowledge beyond spoken memory.
short: Writing preserved laws, records, stories and knowledge beyond spoken memory.

title: Mesopotamia
description: Mesopotamian cities developed early systems of administration, writing, trade and monumental architecture.
short: Mesopotamian cities developed early systems of administration, writing, trade and monumental architecture.

title: Ancient Greece
description: The Greek world shaped later traditions in philosophy, mathematics, political thought, drama and scientific inquiry.
short: The Greek world shaped later traditions in philosophy, mathematics, political thought, drama and scientific inquiry.

title: Democracy
description: Democracy grounds political authority in the people and has roots in several ancient societies and many modern forms.
short: Democracy grounds political authority in the people and has roots in several ancient societies and many modern forms.

title: Roman Empire
description: Roman institutions, engineering, law, roads and language influenced societies across Europe, North Africa and western Asia.
short: Roman institutions, engineering, law, roads and language influenced societies across Europe, North Africa and western Asia.

title: Silk Road
description: A network of land and sea routes that moved goods, technologies, beliefs and diseases across Eurasia.
short: A network of land and sea routes that moved goods, technologies, beliefs and diseases across Eurasia.

title: Paper
description: Paper offered a portable and economical surface for recording information, transforming administration, education and publishing.
short: Paper offered a portable and economical surface for recording information, transforming administration, education and publishing.

title: Magnetic Compass
description: The magnetic compass enabled more reliable orientation and became vital for overland and maritime navigation.
short: The magnetic compass enabled more reliable orientation and became vital for overland and maritime navigation.

title: Gunpowder
description: Developed in China, gunpowder changed warfare and later influenced mining, engineering and artillery.
short: Developed in China, gunpowder changed warfare and later influenced mining, engineering and artillery.

title: Nicolaus Copernicus
description: Copernicus proposed a heliocentric model in which Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.
short: Copernicus proposed a heliocentric model in which Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.

title: Galileo Galilei
description: Galileo used telescopic observations and experiments to reshape astronomy and the study of motion.
short: Galileo used telescopic observations and experiments to reshape astronomy and the study of motion.

title: Telescope
description: The telescope made distant celestial objects observable in greater detail and transformed astronomy.
short: The telescope made distant celestial objects observable in greater detail and transformed astronomy.

title: Microscope
description: The microscope revealed structures too small to see unaided, opening new paths in biology and medicine.
short: The microscope revealed structures too small to see unaided, opening new paths in biology and medicine.

title: Scientific Method
description: Observation, measurement, hypothesis testing and revision help build reliable explanations of the natural world.
short: Observation, measurement, hypothesis testing and revision help build reliable explanations of the natural world.

title: Michael Faraday
description: Faraday's experiments on electromagnetic induction established principles behind electric generators and transformers.
short: Faraday's experiments on electromagnetic induction established principles behind electric generators and transformers.

title: James Clerk Maxwell
description: Maxwell unified electricity, magnetism and light in equations central to modern physics and communications.
short: Maxwell unified electricity, magnetism and light in equations central to modern physics and communications.

title: Telephone
description: The telephone transmits speech over electrical networks, reshaping personal and business communication.
short: The telephone transmits speech over electrical networks, reshaping personal and business communication.

title: Radio
description: Radio transmits information wirelessly and became central to broadcasting, navigation and communication.
short: Radio transmits information wirelessly and became central to broadcasting, navigation and communication.

title: Airplane
description: Powered flight transformed travel, trade, warfare and how people understand distance.
short: Powered flight transformed travel, trade, warfare and how people understand distance.

title: Germ Theory
description: Germ theory explains that many diseases are caused by microorganisms, transforming hygiene, surgery and public health.
short: Germ theory explains that many diseases are caused by microorganisms, transforming hygiene, surgery and public health.

title: Penicillin
description: Penicillin became the first widely used antibiotic and transformed treatment of bacterial infections.
short: Penicillin became the first widely used antibiotic and transformed treatment of bacterial infections.

title: Smallpox
description: A highly contagious disease that caused immense suffering; vaccination campaigns led to its global eradication in 1980.
short: A highly contagious disease that caused immense suffering; vaccination campaigns led to its global eradication in 1980.

title: Black Death
description: The Black Death devastated populations across Europe, Asia and North Africa and reshaped economies and social life.
short: The Black Death devastated populations across Europe, Asia and North Africa and reshaped economies and social life.

title: Leonardo da Vinci
description: Leonardo combined art, engineering and observation, exemplifying the broad curiosity associated with the Renaissance.
short: Leonardo combined art, engineering and observation, exemplifying the broad curiosity associated with the Renaissance.

title: Algebra
description: Algebra expresses relationships and solves problems using symbols and general rules.
short: Algebra expresses relationships and solves problems using symbols and general rules.

title: Zero
description: Zero as a number and positional placeholder was essential to decimal place value and modern mathematics.
short: Zero as a number and positional placeholder was essential to decimal place value and modern mathematics.

title: Indus Valley Civilisation
description: The Indus Valley Civilisation built planned cities with drainage, standardized weights and extensive South Asian trade.
short: The Indus Valley Civilisation built planned cities with drainage, standardized weights and extensive South Asian trade.

title: Buddhism
description: Buddhism emerged in ancient India and spread across Asia through teaching, travel, translation and trade networks.
short: Buddhism emerged in ancient India and spread across Asia through teaching, travel, translation and trade networks.

title: Big Bang
description: The leading scientific model describes the universe expanding from an extremely hot, dense early state. It is supported by observations including cosmic expansion and the cosmic microwave background.
short: The leading scientific model describes the universe expanding from an extremely hot, dense early state. It is supported by observations including cosmic expansion and the cosmic microwave background.

title: Edwin Hubble
description: Hubble's observations of distant galaxies showed that the universe is expanding, transforming modern cosmology.
short: Hubble's observations of distant galaxies showed that the universe is expanding, transforming modern cosmology.

title: Quantum Mechanics
description: Quantum mechanics describes matter and energy at atomic and subatomic scales, providing the foundation for much of modern physics and electronics.
short: Quantum mechanics describes matter and energy at atomic and subatomic scales, providing the foundation for much of modern physics and electronics.

title: Marie Curie
description: Marie Curie's research on radioactivity led to the discovery of polonium and radium and changed the study of atomic physics and medicine.
short: Marie Curie's research on radioactivity led to the discovery of polonium and radium and changed the study of atomic physics and medicine.

title: Radioactivity
description: Radioactivity is the spontaneous emission of radiation from unstable atomic nuclei, a phenomenon central to nuclear science and medical imaging.
short: Radioactivity is the spontaneous emission of radiation from unstable atomic nuclei, a phenomenon central to nuclear science and medical imaging.

title: X-rays
description: X-rays made it possible to see inside the human body without surgery and became essential to medical diagnosis and material science.
short: X-rays made it possible to see inside the human body without surgery and became essential to medical diagnosis and material science.

title: Insulin
description: The discovery and therapeutic use of insulin transformed type 1 diabetes from a usually fatal condition into a manageable chronic disease.
short: The discovery and therapeutic use of insulin transformed type 1 diabetes from a usually fatal condition into a manageable chronic disease.

title: Human Genome Project
description: An international research effort produced a reference sequence of the human genome, accelerating genetics, biology and precision medicine.
short: An international research effort produced a reference sequence of the human genome, accelerating genetics, biology and precision medicine.

title: CRISPR
description: CRISPR-based tools made targeted genome editing more accessible and opened new possibilities and ethical questions in biology and medicine.
short: CRISPR-based tools made targeted genome editing more accessible and opened new possibilities and ethical questions in biology and medicine.

title: French Revolution
description: The French Revolution challenged monarchy and privilege, reshaped political institutions and helped spread ideas of citizenship and popular sovereignty.
short: The French Revolution challenged monarchy and privilege, reshaped political institutions and helped spread ideas of citizenship and popular sovereignty.

title: American Revolution
description: The thirteen colonies' break from British rule produced the United States and influenced later debates about republican government and rights.
short: The thirteen colonies' break from British rule produced the United States and influenced later debates about republican government and rights.

title: Gutenberg Bible
description: Among the earliest major books printed in Europe with movable metal type, the Gutenberg Bible demonstrates the scale and craft of early printing.
short: Among the earliest major books printed in Europe with movable metal type, the Gutenberg Bible demonstrates the scale and craft of early printing.

title: Mughal Empire
description: The Mughal Empire governed much of the Indian subcontinent and shaped its architecture, administration, languages, art and foodways.
short: The Mughal Empire governed much of the Indian subcontinent and shaped its architecture, administration, languages, art and foodways.

title: Bengal Renaissance
description: A period of social, literary, educational and scientific reform in Bengal, involving figures who debated modernity, identity and social change.
short: A period of social, literary, educational and scientific reform in Bengal, involving figures who debated modernity, identity and social change.

title: Bengali Language Movement
description: The movement in East Bengal demanded recognition of Bengali as a state language of Pakistan; its legacy is commemorated on International Mother Language Day.
short: The movement in East Bengal demanded recognition of Bengali as a state language of Pakistan; its legacy is commemorated on International Mother Language Day.

title: Bangladesh Liberation War
description: The 1971 war led to the independence of Bangladesh after a struggle involving mass displacement, atrocities and a decisive military campaign.
short: The 1971 war led to the independence of Bangladesh after a struggle involving mass displacement, atrocities and a decisive military campaign.

title: Dhaka
description: Dhaka grew as an important Mughal provincial capital and later became the capital of Bangladesh, shaped by rivers, trade and migration.
short: Dhaka grew as an important Mughal provincial capital and later became the capital of Bangladesh, shaped by rivers, trade and migration.

title: The Sundarbans
description: The Sundarbans is a vast tidal mangrove forest shared by Bangladesh and India, known for its biodiversity and importance to coastal protection.
short: The Sundarbans is a vast tidal mangrove forest shared by Bangladesh and India, known for its biodiversity and importance to coastal protection.

title: Rabindranath Tagore
description: Tagore reshaped Bengali literature and music and became the first non-European Nobel laureate in Literature in 1913.
short: Tagore reshaped Bengali literature and music and became the first non-European Nobel laureate in Literature in 1913.

title: Jagadish Chandra Bose
description: Bose pioneered research in radio and microwave optics and later investigated plant physiology, working across disciplinary boundaries.
short: Bose pioneered research in radio and microwave optics and later investigated plant physiology, working across disciplinary boundaries.

title: Pala Empire
description: The Pala dynasty ruled large parts of Bengal and Bihar and supported Buddhist institutions, scholarship and art across Asia.
short: The Pala dynasty ruled large parts of Bengal and Bihar and supported Buddhist institutions, scholarship and art across Asia.

title: Monsoon
description: Seasonal wind reversals bring concentrated rainfall across South and Southeast Asia, shaping agriculture, settlement and everyday life.
short: Seasonal wind reversals bring concentrated rainfall across South and Southeast Asia, shaping agriculture, settlement and everyday life.

title: Movable Type
description: Movable type was developed in China centuries before Gutenberg's European press, with technologies and materials evolving across regions.
short: Movable type was developed in China centuries before Gutenberg's European press, with technologies and materials evolving across regions.

title: Railway
description: Railways connected cities and markets at unprecedented speed and became central to industrialization, migration and empire.
short: Railways connected cities and markets at unprecedented speed and became central to industrialization, migration and empire.

title: Mobile Phone
description: Mobile telephony evolved from early cellular prototypes into global networks that reshaped personal communication and access to information.
short: Mobile telephony evolved from early cellular prototypes into global networks that reshaped personal communication and access to information.

title: Photography
description: Photography changed how people record events, represent identity and communicate evidence, art and memory.
short: Photography changed how people record events, represent identity and communicate evidence, art and memory.

title: Cinema
description: Moving pictures developed into a global art and entertainment medium that shapes shared stories, politics and popular culture.
short: Moving pictures developed into a global art and entertainment medium that shapes shared stories, politics and popular culture.

title: Open Source Software
description: Open-source software makes source code available for inspection, modification and redistribution, supporting collaborative development across the world.
short: Open-source software makes source code available for inspection, modification and redistribution, supporting collaborative development across the world.

title: Renewable Energy
description: Solar, wind, hydro and other renewable sources provide energy from naturally replenished processes and are central to decarbonizing electricity systems.
short: Solar, wind, hydro and other renewable sources provide energy from naturally replenished processes and are central to decarbonizing electricity systems.

title: Edward Jenner
description: Jenner's work using cowpox to protect against smallpox helped establish vaccination and eventually contributed to the eradication of the disease.
short: Jenner's work using cowpox to protect against smallpox helped establish vaccination and eventually contributed to the eradication of the disease.

title: Satyendra Nath Bose
short: A physicist whose work helped shape quantum statistics.
description: Satyendra Nath Bose was a Bengali physicist whose 1924 work on quantum statistics helped establish the foundation of Bose-Einstein statistics. The class of particles that follows this statistical description is named bosons in his honour.

title: Begum Rokeya
short: A Bengali writer and advocate of women's education.
description: Begum Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain was a Bengali writer, educator and social reformer. Her 1905 satire Sultana's Dream imagined a society led by women, while her work and educational initiatives challenged restrictions on women's learning and public life.

title: Battle of Plassey
short: A turning point in the East India Company's rise in Bengal.
description: Fought on 23 June 1757, the Battle of Plassey pitted the forces of Nawab Siraj ud-Daulah against the British East India Company led by Robert Clive. The Nawab's defeat, amid defections among his commanders, opened the way for the Company to expand its political and revenue power in Bengal.

title: Permanent Settlement
short: A colonial land system that reshaped rural Bengal.
description: Introduced by the East India Company in 1793 under Governor-General Lord Cornwallis, the Permanent Settlement fixed the land revenue owed by zamindars to the colonial state and recognised them as proprietors. Cultivators did not receive equivalent protections, and the system reshaped agrarian power and rent relations in Bengal.

title: Partition of Bengal
short: A controversial division that transformed politics in Bengal.
description: The British government partitioned Bengal on 16 October 1905, creating the province of Eastern Bengal and Assam alongside a reorganised western province. Officials presented the change as administrative reorganisation, while opposition to it fuelled the Swadeshi movement. The partition was annulled in 1911.

title: Swadeshi Movement
short: A campaign for locally made goods and resistance to partition.
description: The Swadeshi movement grew in response to the 1905 Partition of Bengal. Supporters promoted locally made goods, boycotted many British imports and built campaigns around education, public meetings and indigenous enterprise. Its social and political character varied across communities and regions.

title: Somapura Mahavihara
short: A major Buddhist learning centre at Paharpur, Bangladesh.
description: Built under the Pala ruler Dharmapala, Somapura Mahavihara at Paharpur became a renowned Buddhist intellectual centre. Its monumental central shrine, quadrangular monastery and terracotta decoration influenced Buddhist architecture beyond Bengal. UNESCO inscribed the ruins as a World Heritage Site in 1985.

title: University of Dhaka
short: An institution central to education and public life in Bangladesh.
description: The University of Dhaka began teaching on 1 July 1921 with faculties of Arts, Science and Law. Its students, teachers and alumni later played important roles in the intellectual, cultural and political life of the region, including movements that shaped Bangladesh.

title: Six-Point Movement
short: A programme demanding far-reaching autonomy for East Pakistan.
description: Presented by Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in 1966, the Six-Point Programme called for a federal structure with limited central powers and substantial autonomy for East Pakistan, including control over taxation and economic policy. It became a major organising platform in the political struggle that preceded Bangladesh's independence.

title: Mass Uprising of 1969
short: A mass movement that challenged military rule in East Pakistan.
description: The 1969 mass uprising brought students, workers and wider sections of society into protests against the Ayub Khan regime in Pakistan. The movement helped force the withdrawal of the Agartala Conspiracy Case and the release of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, weakening the regime's authority in East Pakistan.

title: Bengal Famine of 1943
short: A devastating famine in wartime Bengal.
description: The Bengal famine of 1943 caused mass starvation and disease across the region during the Second World War. Historians examine interacting causes including wartime disruption, inflation, food-market failures, policy decisions and unequal access to food. Estimates of deaths vary by source and method.

title: The Bengal Delta
short: A river-shaped region with a long, connected history.
description: The Bengal delta is formed by the Ganges, Brahmaputra and Meghna river systems. Its waterways, fertile floodplains and links to the Bay of Bengal shaped settlement, agriculture, trade and cultural exchange across a region that today spans Bangladesh and parts of eastern India.

title: Binary Number System
description: The two-symbol system at the heart of digital computing.
short: The two-symbol system at the heart of digital computing.

title: Algorithms
description: Step-by-step methods for solving problems, from arithmetic to search engines.
short: Step-by-step methods for solving problems, from arithmetic to search engines.

title: Calculus
description: A mathematical language for change and accumulation, developed independently by Newton and Leibniz.
short: A mathematical language for change and accumulation, developed independently by Newton and Leibniz.

title: Cryptography

short: The science of protecting information through codes, ciphers and modern mathematical systems.

title: Linux
description: An open-source operating-system kernel that powers servers, supercomputers, phones and embedded devices.
short: An open-source operating-system kernel that powers servers, supercomputers, phones and embedded devices.

title: Microprocessor
description: A central processing unit built onto a single integrated circuit, enabling compact and affordable computing.
short: A central processing unit built onto a single integrated circuit, enabling compact and affordable computing.

title: Integrated Circuit
description: A complete electronic circuit fabricated on a small semiconductor chip, enabling modern digital electronics.
short: A complete electronic circuit fabricated on a small semiconductor chip, enabling modern digital electronics.

title: Cloud Computing
description: On-demand computing resources delivered over networks, changing how software and infrastructure are operated.
short: On-demand computing resources delivered over networks, changing how software and infrastructure are operated.

title: Blockchain
description: A shared digital ledger structure best known for underpinning Bitcoin and other decentralized systems.
short: A shared digital ledger structure best known for underpinning Bitcoin and other decentralized systems.

title: Machine Learning
description: Methods that allow computers to learn patterns from data and improve at tasks without explicit step-by-step rules.
short: Methods that allow computers to learn patterns from data and improve at tasks without explicit step-by-step rules.

title: Artificial Neural Network
description: A family of computing models inspired by networks of connected neurons, central to modern deep learning.
short: A family of computing models inspired by networks of connected neurons, central to modern deep learning.

title: Theory of Relativity
description: Einstein's theories changed the understanding of space, time, gravity and the relationship between mass and energy.
short: Einstein's theories changed the understanding of space, time, gravity and the relationship between mass and energy.

title: Periodic Table
description: A systematic arrangement of chemical elements that reveals recurring patterns in their properties.
short: A systematic arrangement of chemical elements that reveals recurring patterns in their properties.

title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
description: A non-invasive imaging technique that uses magnetic fields and radio waves to create detailed images inside the body.
short: A non-invasive imaging technique that uses magnetic fields and radio waves to create detailed images inside the body.

title: Exoplanets
description: Planets orbiting stars beyond the Sun have revealed that planetary systems are common and remarkably diverse.
short: Planets orbiting stars beyond the Sun have revealed that planetary systems are common and remarkably diverse.

title: Hubble Space Telescope
description: A space-based observatory whose images and measurements transformed astronomy and public views of the universe.
short: A space-based observatory whose images and measurements transformed astronomy and public views of the universe.

title: Black Holes
description: Regions of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape from within the event horizon.
short: Regions of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape from within the event horizon.

title: Mars Exploration Rovers
description: Robotic missions that explored Mars and gathered evidence about the planet's ancient environments and geology.
short: Robotic missions that explored Mars and gathered evidence about the planet's ancient environments and geology.

title: Silk
description: A prized textile whose production and trade connected East Asia with distant markets and helped name the Silk Road.
short: A prized textile whose production and trade connected East Asia with distant markets and helped name the Silk Road.

title: Olympic Games
description: An ancient Greek athletic festival revived in the modern era as an international sporting event.
short: An ancient Greek athletic festival revived in the modern era as an international sporting event.

title: Jazz
description: A musical form rooted in African American communities, known for improvisation, syncopation and evolving styles.
short: A musical form rooted in African American communities, known for improvisation, syncopation and evolving styles.

title: Mona Lisa
description: Leonardo da Vinci's portrait became one of the world's most recognised paintings and an enduring subject of art history.
short: Leonardo da Vinci's portrait became one of the world's most recognised paintings and an enduring subject of art history.

title: William Shakespeare
description: An English playwright and poet whose works continue to shape theatre, literature and the English language.
short: An English playwright and poet whose works continue to shape theatre, literature and the English language.

short: J. K. Rowling's fantasy series became a global publishing phenomenon and influenced modern popular culture.

title: Public Education

short: The expansion of organised schooling reshaped literacy, citizenship, social mobility and modern states.

short: The movement of people across regions and borders has shaped populations, languages, economies and cultures.

short: An international organisation founded after World War II to support cooperation, peace, security and human rights.

short: The world's largest tropical rainforest, vital to biodiversity, regional climate and global carbon cycles.

title: Ozone Layer

short: A region of the stratosphere that absorbs much of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation and became a focus of global environmental action.

title: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar
description: A Bengali educator and reformer who campaigned for education, widow remarriage and social change.
short: A Bengali educator and reformer who campaigned for education, widow remarriage and social change.

title: Kazi Nazrul Islam
description: The Bengali poet known as the Rebel Poet, whose writing and music challenged oppression and celebrated human freedom.
short: The Bengali poet known as the Rebel Poet, whose writing and music challenged oppression and celebrated human freedom.

title: Muslin of Bengal

short: Fine cotton muslin produced in Bengal became renowned in international trade for its lightness and craftsmanship.

title: Bangla Language
description: An Indo-Aryan language with a rich literary history and a central place in the cultural identity of Bangladesh and West Bengal.
